story_title: Endava Redesigns Software Delivery Around OpenAI AI Agents
caption:
AI coding tools are evolving fast. Enterprise technology firm Endava is moving beyond simple AI autocomplete and actively redesigning its software delivery pipeline around OpenAI AI agents, ChatGPT Enterprise, and Codex.

Instead of treating AI as an isolated tool for individual developers, the focus is shifting toward AI-native culture and workflow automation across the whole dev lifecycle.

Are you using AI as an assistant, or redesigning your process around agents?

alt_text_overall: Carousel breakdown by GetByteRush explaining how software firm Endava is redesigning software delivery around OpenAI AI agents and ChatGPT Enterprise.
alt_text_per_slide: Slide 1: THE AI DEV IS NO LONGER JUST AN ASSISTANT.. Global technology consultant Endava is quietly rebuilding its software delivery architecture around OpenAI AI agents. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.

Slide 2: NOT JUST CODE PROMPTS.. Instead of using AI merely for line-by-line code completion, engineering teams are deploying ChatGPT Enterprise and OpenAI Codex to automate whole workflows. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 3: BUILDING AN AI-NATIVE CULTURE.. By integrating ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex directly into team operations, enterprise workflows transition from human execution to human supervision. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 4: FROM HUMAN-FIRST TO AGENT-CENTERED.. When software delivery is redesigned around agents, task delegation changes: humans define architecture while agents handle execution and verification. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 5: SYNTAX IS NO LONGER THE BOTTLENECK.. The real competitive advantage in modern tech isn't typing speed—it's building the operational framework that lets AI agents execute reliably. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 6: WHAT THIS MEANS FOR DEVELOPERS.. Teams that adapt to agentic delivery won't just write code faster—they will operate at a scale that traditional dev teams simply cannot match. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 7: THE FUTURE BELONGS TO AGENTIC ARCHITECTURE.. Using AI as a simple plugin is yesterday's strategy. Rebuilding your workflows around autonomous AI agents is the new baseline. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.
